{{Top|leg}}
The '''ion encumbrance system''' was a unique system fitted to the [[Vana Sage]]'s [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the ''[[Guardian Mantis]]''.<ref name="Starfighter">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]</ref> The system launched small ion-enabled "tags", projectiles which attached to enemy vessels and caused an ionization effect which disabled their [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].<ref name="TCSWE ion-enabled sensor tag">{{CSWECite|II|112|ion-enabled sensor tag}}</ref> They could be used in conjunction with [[Nano missile|nano-missiles]] as a guidance system.<ref name="TCSWE nano-missile">{{CSWECite|II|359|nano-missile}}</ref>
